about: A frozen reference: what the Fabric renderer gave for this test, recorded by running it (FABRIC_REFERENCE=record). Never edit it by hand, and never record it from the DOM renderer: the Fabric renderer is its only source. See docs/engineering-reference.md.
test: text edited on the DOM renderer saves and records what the Fabric renderer does (paired) > headings and their Enter and Backspace rules, typing shortcuts, Backspace straight after one, and the literal cases

recordedFrom.appSource: the app source (src/ outside tests, index.html, package files, vite.config.ts) as committed
